title: The Harlem Globetrotters
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their all-new Rivalry Tour to the court, facing the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals. Fans can get pulled onto the court, help decide the action, and take over the jumbotron, and a free pre-game tip-off party begins when doors open at 6:00 PM. It is a family-friendly show for all ages, with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families; parking is $20, or $50 for premium, and can be bought in advance or by credit card at the lot entrance.
